description: Clone the active/base design into personalised designs. Supply areaId and variants with nameText, numberText, size, quantity and optional product/items. This replaces existing name/number text objects: first ensure separate name and number templates exist in the intended print area, adding missing templates with add_text. It does not create those text objects itself. Set append:true to retain existing session designs; otherwise the variants replace that collection. Preserve the common artwork and check each supplied name and number. Pass only the complete intended designs to checkout.

options.description: Existing arguments; advanced fields/aliases remain accepted. Supplied design patches can overwrite session content; preview/rendering can fetch public image URLs in those designs. Catalogue/session results include the full designArgumentSchema.

append.description: Retain existing session designs when adding variants. Defaults false, replacing that collection.

designs.description: Pass exact complete designs returned by the session/variant result; preserve product, items, print areas and artwork.

variants.description: New variant rows: nameText, numberText, size, quantity, optional product/items. Checkout uses the complete returned designs.

requestId.description: Generate a UUID for a new action. Reuse it only for retrying/polling that same action and payload. A new user edit needs a new UUID.

sessionToken.description: The private expiring capability returned by start_design_session. Do not publish it.

subject.description: The exact subject returned by start_design_session.

name: create_design_variants
title: Personalise team shirts
